summary.intent: Redesign the session summary TUI from a paginated table with Enter-to-view-details into a split-pane layout with instant detail preview, filter tabs, and a more polished visual style.
summary.outcome: Fully implemented split-pane TUI with custom list renderer (30/70 split), bordered detail sections, inline time/branch filter tabs, and all 24 tests passing with lint-clean code. Changes committed.

repo: summarytui package lives at cmd/entire/cli/summarytui/ with root.go, detail_page.go, styles.go, keys.go
The bubbles/table widget is not suited for narrow 30%-width panes — custom list renderer with lipgloss gives better control
viewport.View() returns empty in tests unless the model receives a proper WindowSizeMsg with height; test assertions should check generated content directly rather than viewport output
rebuildFilteredRows is called inside resize(), so restoreSelection() runs after rebuild, meaning the selected session before resize determines cursor position after resize — test setup order matters
Pre-existing lint issues exist in permissions.go, summary_cmd.go, skilldb/cache.go, memory_loop_cmd_test.go — not introduced by this change

code.finding: Rewrote rootModel: dropped bubbles/table, added custom list renderer, timeFilter/branchFilter fields, split-pane View() using lipgloss.JoinHorizontal, inline detail viewport, cursor management with j/k
Removed detailModel struct entirely; refactored into standalone renderDetailContent function using bordered lipgloss boxes for SESSION, SUMMARY, FRICTION, LEARNINGS, INSIGHTS sections
Added listSelected (amber highlight + left accent), listNormal, boxBorder, boxTitle, filterActive/Inactive/Label styles; removed table-specific styles
Added 1/2 key bindings for cycling filter dimensions, j/k for cursor navigation
RendersSplitPaneLayout test needed to check only the list header line, not the full combined view, because TOKENS appears in the detail pane header on the same render line

workflow: Brainstorming skill + visual companion (HTML mockups served on localhost) is effective for iterating on TUI layout before writing code
Checking compilation after each major file rewrite (before writing tests) catches type errors early
Lint pass after tests revealed unused helper functions (fallback in detail_page.go, manyFacetRowForTest in root_test.go) that tests didn't catch

friction: viewport.View() returning empty in tests caused 3 initial test failures — required switching assertions to check generated content directly

BranchFilter test failure due to resize() calling restoreSelection() which restored the pre-filter-change cursor position, not cursor=0 — required understanding the resize/rebuildFilteredRows/restoreSelection call order
Design spec was gitignored under docs/superpowers/ so the commit of the spec failed silently
Unused fallback function and manyFacetRowForTest helper only caught by lint, not by tests or compilation
open_items: The detail pane metadata header takes fixed vertical space — this is noted in the spec as intentional but could be revisited if the header grows
Pre-existing lint issues in permissions.go, summary_cmd.go, skilldb/cache.go, memory_loop_cmd_test.go were not addressed
